Name: MiniKarma's Seasonal Tent Recolors feat Interior
Author: MiniKarma
Description:
[size=3][size=3]This mod is a resource mod for map modders, adding a new tilesheet containing recolored variants of a tent. It uses Content Patcher to load the tilesheet in the game, allowing other mods to use it as a [b]dependency[/b].[/size][u][b][size=3][u][b]

[/b][/u][/size][/b][/u][/size][size=4][i]To use it, really use it as a dependency. Hell, my [/i][b]own [/b][i]other mods will use it as a dependency. Thank you.[/i][/size][size=3][size=3]
[/size][u][b][size=3][u][b]
